description.narrative: Syftet med projektet är att stödja kvinnors företagande i sydöstra Anatolien genom ökad produktion och marknadsföringsfärdigheter för att generera inkomster och förbättra deras levnadsstandard. UNDP är avtalspart och GAP Administrationen implementerare.

The aim with the project is that Women´s enterprises in Southeast Anatolia have production and marketing skills to generate incomes and improve their life standard. UNDP is the agreement partner and GAP Administration the implementer.

General question: Results related to the intended outcome 2016Question: Summarise results related to the intended outcome (this information will be sent to Open Aid)Answer: The Project had two main objectives: i) Enhanced individual productive and social capacities in order to empower women in Southeast Anatolia within their communities, and ii) Increased incomes for women through increased employment and entrepreneurship opportunities. Both of these have been achieved as the project has contributed to improve women's economic life in the Southeast Anatolia and through their work, trainings and participation at seminars they have gained increased empowerment within their communities.
